parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about
an age is a long stretch of time

indicators.note: the beginner of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone is told to be cautious about time when dealing with a young novice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'young beginner' looks like a novice but means the first letter of 'young'.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe a wary person who gives little away.

parts.note: a puff is a piece of promotional praise, an advertisement, shortened to ad
a failing is a moral fault or vice

explanation.surface: Information is lacking and the promotional hype has fallen flat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'failing' reads as a verb but is the noun meaning a weakness.
explanation.definitionFit: In an older sense, advice means news or information received, like intelligence.

indicators.note: text that needs editing will be reworked, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Pieces of writing need an editor's attention; that much is obvious.
explanation.definitionFit: Articles are individual things or pieces, such as items in a list or on sale.

clue.text: Smoke and so cause much displeasure

explanation.surface: Burning something and so provoking anger.
explanation.definitionFit: Incense is fragrant smoke from burning gums; to incense someone is to make them furious.

indicators.note: the word for eccentric goes around the other piece

parts.note: an eccentric person is odd or strange
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: An odd character holds back on someone around fifty years old.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts L inside STRANGE, making STRAN-L-GE.
explanation.definitionFit: To strangle a feeling, such as a yawn or a cry, is to suppress it.

clue.text: Through swallowing dislike he's given an award

indicators.note: the word for through takes the other piece inside it, as if eating it

parts.note: per means through or by way of, as in per post
to resent is to feel bitter dislike of

explanation.surface: A grudging winner accepts a prize while choking down resentment.
explanation.definitionFit: A presenter is the person who hands over a prize or trophy at a ceremony.

explanation.surface: Overseas bureaucrats insist on having fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: Mandarins were senior officials of imperial China, and a mandarin is also a small citrus like a tangerine.

clue.text: Account for ordinary soldiers being in beastly accommodation

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a sty is housing for pigs, a home for beasts
OR stands for other ranks, soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: Explaining why rank-and-file troops were billeted in a pigsty.
explanation.definitionFit: An account is a narrative or report of events, a tale.

clue.text: Some photographers take pictures of military equipment

indicators.note: only part of the following words is used, so the letters lie within them

explanation.surface: A few press photographers take snaps of army kit.
explanation.definitionFit: A kepi is a French soldier's peaked cap, part of military kit.

clue.text: Laughing father turning into a disreputable place

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a dive is a seedy bar or club

indicators.note: the word for father is read backwards

parts.note: a sire is a father, especially of an animal

explanation.surface: A dad wanders into a seedy joint, and people laugh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' makes ERIS from SIRE; 'into' puts it inside DIVE.
explanation.definitionFit: Derisive means mocking, scornful laughter at someone.

indicators.note: composure hints at composing, so the letters are put together afresh

explanation.surface: A calm request to sneak off quietly.
explanation.definitionFit: Time elapses when it passes or slips by.

explanation.surface: Watering a plant generously.
explanation.definitionFit: A well is a source of water from the ground; well also means fully, as in well mixed.

clue.text: Casting for fish, give voice about it

indicators.note: the word for give voice wraps around the fish

parts.note: to sing is to use the voice musically
a ling is a long food fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: An angler sings while casting a line for fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts LING inside SING, giving S-LING-ING.
explanation.definitionFit: Slinging means throwing, just as casting does.

clue.text: They'll support those in difficulties in the main

definitions.text: They'll support those in difficulties in the main

parts.words: They'll support those in difficulties in the main
parts.note: reads like helpers for people who mostly struggle, but 'the main' is the sea: buoyant rings that keep swimmers afloat

explanation.surface: Something that mostly backs people who are struggling.
explanation.definitionFit: Floating rings thrown to people in trouble at sea hold them up in the water.

clue.text: See dais is badly constructed-make complaint

indicators.note: something poorly built is put together wrongly, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone protests that a platform has been shoddily built.
explanation.definitionFit: A complaint is an illness or ailment, as in a chest complaint.

explanation.surface: Gaining entry by means of a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: An entrance is a way in; to entrance someone is to delight or carry them away, a sense of transport.

parts.note: cove is old British slang for a man or chap
a red is a socialist or communist

explanation.surface: A left-wing chap set up a policy for himself.
explanation.walkthrough: COVE is dated British slang for a fellow.
explanation.definitionFit: Being covered means having an insurance policy that protects against a risk.

parts.note: an appeal or proposal, made by a musician, would be the opening piece of an opera

explanation.surface: Wondering what makes a musician attractive.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a friendly approach or proposal and an orchestral introduction.

clue.text: Made for confusion in female leaders

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a hen is a female bird

indicators.note: made for confusion means the word is thrown into disorder, so its letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Women chiefs were created in order to cause chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for confusion' turns MADE into EADM; 'in' puts it inside HEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Headmen are chiefs of tribes or villages.

clue.text: Just a few words will be fine perhaps

explanation.surface: A brief remark will do nicely.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentence is a short group of words; it is also a punishment set by a court, of which a fine is one kind.

indicators.note: the little word is read backwards

parts.note: el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: A man switches on the Spanish channel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned' makes ON into NO; 'He's' is the definition, a man's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Noel is a man's first name, so it can stand for a male person.

parts.note: reads as agreeing after thought, but means noise bounced back off a surface

explanation.surface: After thinking it over, someone agrees it is a sensible idea.
explanation.definitionFit: A sound wave reflected back to the listener produces a repeat of the noise.

clue.text: The son may be quite trustworthy

indicators.note: suggests the letters could form something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: A father hopes his boy can be relied upon.
explanation.definitionFit: Honest means truthful and reliable, someone who can be trusted.

clue.text: A domestic animal will give way always

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
e'er is poetic shortening of ever, meaning always

explanation.surface: A tame beast will always yield.
explanation.walkthrough: E'ER is the poetic form of ever.
explanation.definitionFit: A steer is a young castrated bull raised for beef, a farm animal.

parts.note: guys are men
an ace is the one in a pack of cards

explanation.surface: A man discovers his friends are dangerous.
explanation.definitionFit: A menace is a danger or threat.

clue.text: Set off to tee and got diverted

indicators.note: something diverted is redirected, so the letters change their order

explanation.surface: A golfer heads for the first tee but takes a detour.
explanation.definitionFit: To set off a bomb is to make it explode.

explanation.surface: A financial holding might turn out to be a blunder.
explanation.definitionFit: Stock is capital invested in shares; stock is also a scented garden flower, one that blooms.

explanation.surface: Putting on make-up after changing outfits.
explanation.definitionFit: To redress is to make good or compensate a wrong; re-dressed also means having put on clothes again.
